description: Gradle dependencies, GitHub Actions pinned by digest, and the OpenSSL pin in gradle/openssl.toml. Nothing is auto-merged.

packageRules.description: Kotlin, the Kotlin Gradle plugin and compiler plugins move together.
AGP stays within the range the pinned Kotlin documents as tested (Kotlin 2.4.20: up to AGP 9.3.x); raise this bound together with Kotlin.
Ktor modules move together; the engines vendor Ktor 3.6.0 code and tests, so a Ktor update needs a manual review of docs/ktor-internal-api.md.
GitHub Actions: pinned by commit digest, grouped, minor and patch only.
OpenSSL: stay on the 3.5 LTS branch, never auto-merge, open the PR immediately (security releases have a 72-hour SLA, see SECURITY.md).
prBodyNotes: **OpenSSL pin update.** Renovate changes only `version` in `gradle/openssl.toml`. Before merging, a maintainer must: (1) download `openssl-<version>.tar.gz` and its `.asc` from the GitHub release, (2) verify the signature against `tools/openssl/openssl-release-key.asc` / `pgp_fingerprint` (update both only if OpenSSL rotated its key, after checking openssl-library.org), (3) put the tarball's SHA-256 into `sha256`, (4) run `tools/openssl/fetch.sh` and the full matrix. Until `sha256` is updated, `fetch.sh` fails on purpose.

customManagers.description: The OpenSSL release pinned in gradle/openssl.toml (version line; the sha256 line is updated by a maintainer, see prBodyNotes).
